project.name: GeraiCUAN
project.summary: A multi-tenant SaaS CMS for Indonesian shipping outlets to create individual or bulk shipments, obtain Mengantar AWBs, and print shipping labels.

architecture.tenancy: Multi-tenant; a platform super administrator manages tenants and tenant administrators operate their own outlets.

in: sender, recipient, package, COD, and declared-value capture
default Mengantar pickup address per tenant outlet
out: custom courier rate or insurance pricing
